cues.speaker: ER
cues.text: Good morning.

cues.speaker: ER
cues.text: My name's Erica Matthews, and I'm the owner of Matthews Island Holidays, a company set up

cues.speaker: ER
cues.text: by my parents.

cues.speaker: ER
cues.text: Thank you for coming to this presentation, in which I hope to interest you in what we

cues.speaker: ER
cues.text: have to offer.

cues.speaker: ER
cues.text: We're a small, family-run company, and we believe in the importance of the personal

cues.speaker: ER
cues.text: touch, so we don't aim to compete with other companies on the number of customers.

cues.speaker: ER
cues.text: What we do is build on our many years' experience – more than almost any other rail

cues.speaker: ER
cues.text: holiday company – to ensure we provide perfect holidays in a small number of

cues.speaker: ER
cues.text: destinations, which we've got to know extremely well.

cues.speaker: ER
cues.text: I'll start with our six-day Isle of Man holiday.

cues.speaker: ER
cues.text: This is a fascinating island in the Irish Sea, with Wales to the south, England to the

cues.speaker: ER
cues.text: east, Scotland to the north and Northern Ireland to the west.

cues.speaker: ER
cues.text: Our holiday starts in Heysham, where your tour manager will meet you, then you'll travel

cues.speaker: ER
cues.text: by ferry to the Isle of Man.

cues.speaker: ER
cues.text: Some people prefer to fly from Luton instead, and another popular option is to go by

cues.speaker: ER
cues.text: train to Liverpool and take a ferry from there.

cues.speaker: ER
cues.text: You have five nights in the hotel, and the price covers five breakfasts and dinners, and

cues.speaker: ER
cues.text: lunch on the three days when there are organised trips: day four is free, and most people

cues.speaker: ER
cues.text: have lunch in a café or restaurant in Douglas.

cues.speaker: ER
cues.text: The price of the holiday includes the ferry to the Isle of Man, all travel on the island,

cues.speaker: ER
cues.text: the hotel, and the meals I've mentioned.

cues.speaker: ER
cues.text: Incidentally, we try to make booking our holidays as simple and fair as possible, so

cues.speaker: ER
cues.text: unlike with many companies, the price is the same whether you book six months in advance

cues.speaker: ER
cues.text: or at the last minute, and there's no supplement for single rooms in hotels.

cues.speaker: ER
cues.text: If you make a booking then need to change the start date, for example because of illness,

cues.speaker: ER
cues.text: you're welcome to change to an alternative date or a different tour, for a small

cues.speaker: ER
cues.text: administrative fee.
